title: Arashiyama, Zen garden and Gion at night

map.after: Then taxi to K37 Ryōan-ji (~15–20 min, 11:10–12:00), and taxi back to the hotel (~25–30 min).

items.text: Morning: Arashiyama before the crowds (moved from Sun 15)
Leave the hotel. Konbini breakfast on the way.
Walk to Kyoto-Kawaramachi (~15 min), Hankyu Kyoto Line to Katsura, change to the Arashiyama Line to Arashiyama (¥240). Check the weekday timetable.
~7 min from the station, on the way. Just after sunrise (~6:35). Free.
Togetsukyō → north to the lower end of the bamboo path (use the Bamboo path pin).
Before the crowds. Open 24 h, free.
Garden via the north gate on the bamboo path (¥500). Early opening from 7:30 on 14–30 Nov. Halls (+¥300, from 8:30) and Cloud Dragon don't fit before Ōkōchi.
Free gap before Ōkōchi opens: short climb to the gorge view.
Or a quiet walk in Kameyama park (the deck is inside it).
Probably not: opens 9:00 (after the gap), ~200 steps, across the river.
Probably not: opens 9:00, clashes with Ōkōchi; across the river.
Up the top end of the bamboo path to Ōkōchi Sansō.
Villa garden (¥1,000; keep the ticket for the matcha and sweet). This is the snack before the tour. Kept to 1 h so K35 and K36 still fit.
North through the Ogura-yama lanes, past Jōjakkō-ji and Nison-in, to Giō-ji.
Moss garden (¥300). 📿 stamp.
~5 min north of Giō-ji. Free. With K35 and K36 the rest of the day is ~50 min later and K9 gets tight.
8,000 stone memorials and a small quiet bamboo path (¥500, 9:00–16:30). Then taxi to Ryōan-ji.
Taxi from Giō-ji (or Adashino) to Ryōan-ji. Tram alternative: walk to Randen Arashiyama, change at Katabiranotsuji to Ryōanji (~40 min with walks).
Taxi back to the hotel (Kawaramachi Gojō).
Lunch near the hotel or Gojō, chosen on the spot.
Afternoon: suitcases, Zen garden and the city view

Suitcases to Osaka. First option: Yamato Shimogyo Center (Oe-cho 556, Matsubara, Higashitoin-dori; ~1 km), hold at Yamato Namba Station Center, collect Thu 19 ~18:30. Second option: Japan Post at Yanagibaba-Matsubara Post Office (counter to 17:00), hold at Nishinari Tamade Post Office, collect Fri 20. Keep small bags for Yoshino. Pick the suitcases up at the hotel first.
To Kennin-ji, south end of Hanamikoji.
Twin dragons, Wind and Thunder Gods screens, ○△□ garden. ¥800, last entry 16:00. 📿 stamp.
Taxi up the Higashiyama Driveway to Shōgunzuka (no weekday bus).
Deck over the city, Blue Fudō hall, maple garden. ¥600, closes 17:00 (sunset ~16:50 comes after closing).
Taxi back down to Gion (ask reception to call one if none is waiting).
Free gap ~16:45–17:45: snack or rest (the hotel is ~20 min walk).
Evening: Gion night walk (booked)
Meet 17:50 at the Minamiza Theater entrance. Route: Shirakawa (K2a), Tatsumi shrine, Yasaka Shrine, Ryōzen Kannon, Ninenzaka, Hōkan-ji, Yasui Kompira-gū, Hanamikoji (K2b), Ichiriki-tei (K2c).
Dinner in Pontochō, ~10 min west across the river; indoor only in November, last orders vary.
Early night: Wed 18 starts at 5:35 (Fushimi Inari at dawn).
